issues.problem: Context 1 'テストの山をかけたら' is an unnatural collocation; the idiom takes で for the test (テストで山をかける) or テストのヤマ as a noun with 当たる.
issues.action: Changed to 'テストで山をかけたら、見事に当たった。'

issues.problem: Context 5 English 'I can't stand' overstates a vague instinctive dislike.
issues.action: Changed to 'that rubs me the wrong way'.

issues.problem: Context 2 English 'as if I'm dreaming' drifts from the bewitched/baffled sense.
issues.action: Changed to 'as if I've been bewitched'.

issues.problem: Stories: all null. None of these idioms has a single traditionally told origin with a source sure enough to state (金に糸目 kite strings and 鶴の一声 from 雀の千声鶴の一声 are already given as the image in lit).
